title: The Shared Water Tank
central_conflict: two gardens received too little water from their shared tank
decisive_choice: a hidden leak beneath the connecting pipe was wasting the supply
resolution: patched the pipe and agreed on a fair watering schedule
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered two gardens received too little water from their shared tank before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they opened both taps wider, but the tank emptied even faster; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a hidden leak beneath the connecting pipe was wasting the supply; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they patched the pipe and agreed on a fair watering schedule, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Late Festival Clock
central_conflict: the tower clock announced the festival an hour too late
decisive_choice: the pendulum was brushing a loose banner on each swing
resolution: moved the banner and checked the clock against the town bell
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the tower clock announced the festival an hour too late before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they reset the hands, but the clock fell behind again by noon; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the pendulum was brushing a loose banner on each swing; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they moved the banner and checked the clock against the town bell, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Misleading Echo
central_conflict: a distress whistle seemed to come from the abandoned quarry
decisive_choice: the canyon wall was reflecting a whistle from the opposite ridge
resolution: followed the direct sound and helped the stranded traveler return
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a distress whistle seemed to come from the abandoned quarry before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they searched the quarry, but nobody was there to answer; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the canyon wall was reflecting a whistle from the opposite ridge; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they followed the direct sound and helped the stranded traveler return, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
